hints.title: Endpoint Distance Upper Bounds
hints.text: The greatest possible index separation must involve either the first element or the last element.

hints.title: Two-directional Boundary Scan
hints.text: Find the furthest right element differing from index 0, and the furthest left element differing from index n-1.

hints.title: Max Gap Selection
hints.text: Take the maximum of the two candidate endpoint separations.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Two linear scans from boundary endpoints.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all pairs in nested loops takes quadratic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that the optimal pair must include index 0 or index n-1.
